INSERT INTO attendance_group_assignment ( attendance_group_assignment_id, employee_id, attendance_group_revision_id, effective_from, supersedes_assignment_id, snapshot_digest, change_reason, created_by, created_at ) SELECT #{row.attendanceGroupAssignmentId}, #{row.employeeId}, timeline.attendance_group_revision_id, #{row.effectiveFrom}, #{predecessorAssignmentId}, #{row.snapshotDigest}, #{row.changeReason}, #{row.updatedBy}, #{row.updatedAt} FROM attendance_group_timeline timeline JOIN attendance_group scoped ON scoped.attendance_group_id = timeline.attendance_group_id JOIN employee assigned_employee ON assigned_employee.employee_id = #{row.employeeId} AND assigned_employee.company_id = scoped.company_id WHERE timeline.attendance_group_id = #{row.attendanceGroupId} AND timeline.state = 'ACTIVE' AND timeline.business_effective_from <= #{row.effectiveFrom} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_group_timeline newer WHERE newer.attendance_group_id = timeline.attendance_group_id AND newer.business_effective_from <= #{row.effectiveFrom} AND newer.business_effective_from > timeline.business_effective_from )

INSERT INTO attendance_group_assignment ( attendance_group_assignment_id, employee_id, attendance_group_revision_id, effective_from, supersedes_assignment_id, snapshot_digest, change_reason, created_by, created_at ) SELECT #{row.attendanceGroupAssignmentId}, #{row.employeeId}, #{row.attendanceGroupRevisionId}, #{row.effectiveFrom}, #{predecessorAssignmentId}, #{row.snapshotDigest}, #{row.changeReason}, #{row.createdBy}, #{row.createdAt} FROM attendance_group_assignment predecessor JOIN attendance_group_revision predecessor_revision ON predecessor_revision.attendance_group_revision_id = predecessor.attendance_group_revision_id JOIN attendance_group predecessor_group ON predecessor_group.attendance_group_id = predecessor_revision.attendance_group_id JOIN attendance_group_revision successor_revision ON successor_revision.attendance_group_revision_id = #{row.attendanceGroupRevisionId} JOIN attendance_group successor_group ON successor_group.attendance_group_id = successor_revision.attendance_group_id JOIN employee assigned_employee ON assigned_employee.employee_id = #{row.employeeId} AND assigned_employee.company_id = successor_group.company_id WHERE predecessor.attendance_group_assignment_id = #{predecessorAssignmentId} AND predecessor.employee_id = #{row.employeeId} AND predecessor_group.attendance_group_id = successor_group.attendance_group_id AND predecessor_group.company_id = successor_group.company_id AND predecessor.attendance_group_revision_id <> #{row.attendanceGroupRevisionId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_group_assignment existing_successor WHERE existing_successor.supersedes_assignment_id = predecessor.attendance_group_assignment_id )
mapper.select: SELECT attendance_assignment_timeline_id FROM attendance_assignment_timeline WHERE attendance_group_assignment_id = #{assignmentId} ORDER BY event_sequence DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_assignment_timeline ( attendance_assignment_timeline_id, attendance_group_assignment_id, employee_id, event_sequence, state, business_effective_from, predecessor_timeline_id, recorded_at, actor_id, request_id ) SELECT #{row.timelineId}, #{row.contentId}, #{row.employeeId}, #{row.eventSequence}, #{row.state}, #{row.businessEffectiveFrom}, #{row.predecessorTimelineId}, #{row.recordedAt}, #{row.actorId}, #{row.requestId} FROM attendance_group_assignment assignment JOIN attendance_group_revision group_revision ON group_revision.attendance_group_revision_id = assignment.attendance_group_revision_id JOIN attendance_group scoped ON scoped.attendance_group_id = group_revision.attendance_group_id JOIN employee assigned_employee ON assigned_employee.employee_id = assignment.employee_id AND assigned_employee.company_id = scoped.company_id WHERE assignment.attendance_group_assignment_id = #{row.contentId} AND assignment.employee_id = #{row.employeeId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_group_assignment assignment JOIN attendance_group_revision group_revision ON group_revision.attendance_group_revision_id = assignment.attendance_group_revision_id JOIN attendance_group scoped ON scoped.attendance_group_id = group_revision.attendance_group_id JOIN employee assigned_employee ON assigned_employee.employee_id = assignment.employee_id AND assigned_employee.company_id = scoped.company_id WHERE scoped.attendance_group_id = #{groupId} AND ( #{effectiveTo} IS NULL OR assignment.effective_from < #{effectiveTo} ) AND COALESCE( ( SELECT MIN(inactive.business_effective_from) FROM attendance_assignment_timeline inactive WHERE inactive.attendance_group_assignment_id = assignment.attendance_group_assignment_id AND inactive.state = 'INACTIVE' ), CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE) ) > #{effectiveFrom}
